summary: Frontend-only E2E testing for Dhiraj Dayanand portfolio. All requested features verified successfully — page loads, every section renders, navbar/mobile-menu smooth-scrolls, hire-me + experience cards correct, About shows 1.5 stat and 10 skill chips, all 3 portfolio tabs show 4 cards each, dialog modal opens on card click, 2 meta-ad screenshots + 4 result stats render, all 4 social links open in new tab with correct URLs, Thank You heading + Back to Top works, Resume button fires sonner toast, Hire Me CTA opens mailto.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle/Description — generates a11y console warnings on every card open. Wrap with VisuallyHidden DialogTitle for screen-reader compliance.

action_items: (Low priority) Add a visually-hidden DialogTitle inside Portfolio.jsx <DialogContent> to silence Radix a11y warnings.
(Optional) Resume currently shows a toast only — wire to a real PDF when available.
critical_code_review_comments: Portfolio.jsx Dialog lacks DialogTitle/DialogDescription — Radix prints accessibility errors in console each time a card is clicked.
Hero exp-item-0 says 'Jan 2026 — Present' which is the current month; verify with user this is intentional and not a typo for 2025.
All interactive elements expose data-testid as documented — good testability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure static frontend at https://dhiraj-designer.preview.emergentagent.com/. No backend. All data-testids used in review_request were valid and worked. Only console-level a11y warning on Dialog (no functional impact). Mobile menu tested at 390x844 viewport — works.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Only an a11y console warning from Radix DialogContent missing a DialogTitle — fix by wrapping a hidden <DialogTitle> using @radix-ui/react-visually-hidden inside Portfolio.jsx Card's DialogContent.
